hints.title: Monotonic Greedy Structure
hints.text: Maintain a monotonic structure to ensure lexicographically smallest characters appear as early as possible.

hints.title: Capacity and Letter Invariants
hints.text: You can only pop stack top if remaining characters in string plus current stack size exceeds k, and popping does not deplete remaining target letters below required repetition.

hints.title: Target Letter Reservation
hints.text: Push character if stack size has capacity, or if remaining slots must be preserved exclusively for target letters.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(N) each character is pushed and popped at most once
complexity.space: O(k) to maintain the monotonic stack
complexity.notes: Monotonic stack maintains optimal prefix while preserving capacity invariants.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Branching on all k-length combinations yields exponential search space.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Stack-based greedy pruning achieves strictly linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle double capacity constraint: total length k and target letter quota.
